BiblicalUsage: The act of healing is the work itself, the curing as it happens, and Luke uses it where the healing proves the message. In Acts 4:22 the lame man healed was above forty years old, in Acts 4:30 the church prays for signs and wonders to be done by the name of Jesus, and in Luke 13:32 Jesus says he does cures today and tomorrow before he finishes his course.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the healing was never the show: it was the proof that the kingdom had come. The church still prays the same prayer the first believers prayed.
